category.name: OLE Objects
category.preferred_workflow: Create any required sample files locally, then use DocumentBuilder.InsertOleObject with a Stream, the appropriate ProgId, and explicit icon parameters; inspect OLE objects through Shape.OleFormat; for replacement, insert the new object at the parent node and subsequently remove the original shape; always write extracted data to a local file and verify its existence before further processing.

strict_api_bans: Never call undocumented constructors or helpers for OLE insertion; only the documented InsertOleObject overloads may be used.
canonical_patterns: Bootstrap all input assets within the example code and reference them via streams rather than file paths to avoid missing-file errors.
nullable_warning_prevention: Check that any optional icon stream passed to InsertOleObject is non-null when asIcon is true, and verify Shape.OleFormat is not null before accessing its members.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation fails with CS1501 or CS1503 because the argument list does not match any overload.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code supplies parameters in the wrong order or uses unsupported types such as string for a Stream argument.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Use the overload signature InsertOleObject(Stream data, string progId, bool asIcon, Stream presentation) and pass null for the presentation stream when no custom icon is required.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Consult the Aspose.Words API reference for the exact parameter types and order before writing insertion code.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation fails with CS0246 indicating that types like OlePackage, IStorage, or System.Windows.Forms cannot be found.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The example references legacy OLE APIs that are not part of the Aspose.Words assembly or the target .NET framework.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Remove references to unsupported types and rely solely on Aspose.Words.Drawing.OlePackage and related classes that are available in the current package version.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Limit code to the namespaces listed in the product documentation and verify package compatibility with the target framework.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Compilation fails with CS1061 because properties such as FileName, Data, or OleData are not defined on OleFormat.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The code assumes OleFormat exposes file-metadata or raw-data properties that are actually provided by OlePackage.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Retrieve file name and binary data through shape.OleFormat.OlePackage.FileName and shape.OleFormat.OlePackage.Data respectively.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Always navigate through OleFormat.OlePackage for package-level information and avoid direct member access on OleFormat.

common_failure_patterns.pattern: Null icon stream when displaying as icon
common_failure_patterns.symptom: Runtime throws ArgumentNullException for the parameter 'key' during InsertOleObject execution.
common_failure_patterns.cause: The asIcon flag is true while the icon stream argument is null, causing the API to attempt to load a missing system resource.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Pass a valid Stream containing an image when asIcon is true, or set asIcon to false to embed the object without an icon.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Guard the InsertOleObject call with a conditional that supplies a non-null icon stream whenever asIcon is true.

common_failure_patterns.symptom: Runtime fails because the sample file (e.g., spreadsheet, PDF, or image) does not exist at the expected path.
common_failure_patterns.cause: Examples rely on external files that are not created or bundled with the code.
common_failure_patterns.fix: Generate the required sample content programmatically (e.g., using MemoryStream) or write a temporary file before insertion.
common_failure_patterns.prevention: Include asset creation logic at the start of each example to guarantee that all inputs are present.

narrative.overview: The OLE Objects category covers embedding, inspecting, extracting, and replacing OLE content within Word documents using Aspose.Words. Verified examples demonstrate correct insertion of Excel and PDF OLE objects, icon handling, custom sizing, legacy package embedding, and metadata retrieval.
narrative.purpose: Provide an AI coding assistant with concise, authoritative guidance for implementing reliable OLE object workflows in Aspose.Words, ensuring correct API usage, robust error handling, and reproducible results across environments.
validation_priorities: After each InsertOleObject call, confirm that the returned Shape is non-null and that its OleFormat.ProgId matches the expected value.
maintenance_notes: Periodically verify that the InsertOleObject overload signatures have not changed in newer Aspose.Words releases and update the examples accordingly.
